title: research-os experiment record
description: A first-class, schema'd record for a single hypothesis-driven experiment, stored at sessions/{session_id}/experiments/{exp_id}/record.json. Two-tier: a lean required core plus an optional reproducibility extension filled only when comparison/reproduction matters. Structured truth lives here; the human narrative lives in post.md; raw bytes live in code/, runs/, outputs/, figures/.

exp_id.description: Stable experiment id (matches ledger.experiments[].id), not a turn id.

key_metrics.description: Headline scalar metrics, structured for cross-experiment comparison. Required when status == done.

lineage.description: What this experiment builds on. Drives graph derives_from / uses edges.

inputs.description: References to wiki source ids, datasets, or prior experiment ids (e.g. src:..., exp:...).

post_path.description: Relative path to the (Q,S,R,A) post, typically post.md.

repro.description: Optional reproducibility extension. Fill when the experiment must be reproduced or compared.

code_ref.description: git sha, tag, or snapshot path.

config_path.description: Optional pointer to a structured setup/hyperparameter file (config.json|yaml).

runs.description: Optional. Relative paths to per-run subdirectories (seed/config variants), each holding metrics.json, logs/, outputs/.
